composition.serve_who: This sheet serves the Termodinamica marine inverter air conditioning system, comprising port and starboard compressor units (VRV18E1), their associated seawater pumps, and distributed fan coils throughout the vessel's cabins. The conclusion is evidenced by the sheet title 'TERMODINAMICA MARINE INVERTER AIR CONDITIONING SW 108-01 - Wiring Schematic' and the complete network topology of MRMAXI air handlers linked to the VRV18E1 compressors.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Identified as the Port compressor unit ('VRV18E1 ENGINE ROOM PORT') alongside its TMD100 sea water pump, which matches the established fact for Aircon Unit 1.

functions.label: Port AC Compressor & Seawater Cooling Supply
functions.what_it_does: Provides refrigeration capabilities and seawater heat exchange for the port-side air conditioning network.

flow_scenarios.path: Main Switchboard -> via 40 amp C or D curve breaker B1 -> VRV18E1 ENGINE ROOM PORT unit & SEA WATER PUMP TMD100

functions.dry_data: Supply: 230VAC L+N+PE 3x6 mm2; Compressor ground to independent anode
